headline: In 1294 Tabriz was ordered to use Chinese-style paper money on pain of death, and the bazaar shut down until the order was withdrawn

tags: Alves dos Reis;Waterlow & Sons;Banco de Portugal;Banco Angola e Metrópole;500 escudo note;Vasco da Gama note;fraud
amount_original: 580,000 notes of 500 escudos printed and delivered (290,000,000 escudos face value), per House of Lords judgment; note issue increased by about 104,859,000 escudos (≈ £1.09M at 1925 rates) through exchanged notes
amount_today: ≈ 0.9% of Portugal's GDP in 1925 (LSE, Wigan 2004, using Bank of Portugal GDP data). In plain inflation terms, the ≈ £1.0M injected ≈ £78M in 2024 pounds (UK RPI, MeasuringWorth) — a sterling proxy only, not a Portuguese measure. Prefer the share-of-GDP framing.
